mcq.questionText: Machine A starts a task every 8 minutes and Machine B starts a task every 12 minutes. Assuming both start together at time 0, after how many minutes will they next start a task simultaneously?
mcq.explanation: The next simultaneous start occurs at the least common multiple (LCM) of the two periods. LCM(8,12)=24, so after 24 minutes both machines will start a task together again. The other options reflect common misconceptions: using the smaller period (8), the larger period (12), or the product of the periods (96).
